description: Subject metadata for StudyBuddy: canonical topics per subject and a difficulty rating (1-5). Used by the topic-choice flow, intent detection and the study planner.

Mathematics.method: practice-based learning: solve a few problems daily, keep a mistake notebook, and re-derive formulas from memory before checking them.

Maths.method: practice-based learning: solve a few problems daily, keep a mistake notebook, and re-derive formulas from memory before checking them.

Science.method: experiment-first learning: connect every concept to a real phenomenon, then use active recall and practice questions to lock it in.

Physics.method: concept-first practice: learn each law with a real example, then solve problems step by step, and explain the concept out loud (Feynman technique).

Chemistry.method: active recall with mnemonics: turn reactions and properties into flashcards, review on a spaced schedule, and practise balancing equations by hand.

Biology.method: spaced repetition + diagrams: draw each process (e.g. photosynthesis), label it from memory, and use flashcards with a 1-3-7-21 review rhythm.

Computer Science.method: project-based learning: learn a concept, then immediately build a tiny project or solve a coding problem with it — and read the official docs.

Programming.method: build small projects: after every tutorial, write your own version, break it, fix it, and teach it to someone else.

History.method: story method + timelines: turn events into a narrative, make a timeline, and use flashcards for dates and key figures.

Geography.method: map-based learning: sketch maps from memory, link physical features to real places, and use mnemonics for facts like capitals and rivers.

English.method: read, write, revise: read daily, keep a vocabulary notebook, write short summaries, and practise grammar with self-quizzes.

General Knowledge.method: quiz-and-question method: test yourself daily with MCQs, make flashcards for new facts, and connect facts to stories you already know.
